name: Google
description: Personal Google Workspace through Google's official product MCP resources. OAuth tokens stay in the vault and only short-lived access tokens reach Google. Service-account Google Chat remains a separate messaging surface.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.label: OAuth Client ID
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.help: OAuth client ID stored with the app registration in the vault.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.label: OAuth Client Secret
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.help: Bootstrap value imported into the secrets vault before OAuth use. It is never stored on a connector account.

owner.notes: One direct OAuth connection to the user's personal Google account. Agent access is controlled by bindings and selected MCP products.

agent.notes: Personal Google does not create a second agent-identity OAuth account; bind an agent to an authorized user account instead.
